topic: Frozen pipes on New Year's morning
title_jp: {元日|がんじつ}の{朝|あさ}、{水|みず}が{出ない|でない}！
context: Friday 1 January 2027, New Year's Day: the 田中 kitchen tap won't run because a water pipe froze overnight. {由紀|ゆき}, at her parents' house, looks up what to do on LINE, and her {年賀状|ねんがじょう} has arrived.
scene: New Year's morning, minus ten outside. The kitchen tap gives nothing. {由紀|ゆき} messages from her parents' kotatsu.

phrases.jp: {水|みず}が{出なくて|でなくて}、{困って|こまって|to be in trouble, stuck|4}います。
phrases.en: The water isn't running and I'm stuck.
phrases.note: 〜て{困|こま}っています: the standard way to report a problem to a landlord, shop or office.

phrases.jp: {残念|ざんねん|unfortunate, a pity|4}ながら、{今日|きょう}はお{休み|やすみ}です。
phrases.note: {残念|ざんねん}ながら = 'unfortunately'. You'll see it on shop signs all New Year.

phrases.jp: {朝|あさ}から{最悪|さいあく|the worst|4}…{ついてない||out of luck|3}なあ。
phrases.en: The worst, since this morning… I'm so unlucky.
phrases.note: ついてない = luck isn't on my side. Very common grumble.

phrases.jp: {狭い|せまい}ながら、{居心地|いごこち|how comfortable a place feels|3}のいい{部屋|へや}です。
phrases.en: It's small, but it's a cosy room.

phrases.jp: {子|こ}どもながら、よく{気が利く|きがきく|to be thoughtful, attentive|3}ね。
phrases.en: He's only a kid, but he's so thoughtful.

dialogue_setting: LINE, New Year's morning. You're in the freezing 田中 kitchen; {由紀|ゆき} is at her parents' house.

dialogue.speaker: 由紀
dialogue.jp: あけおめ〜🎍ことよろ！{実家|じっか}のこたつから{出られない|でられない}ｗ
dialogue.en: Happy New Year! Let's have a good one! I can't get out of my parents' kotatsu lol
dialogue.note: あけおめ・ことよろ = あけましておめでとう・{今年|ことし}もよろしく.

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: あけおめ！こっちは{元日|がんじつ}から{最悪|さいあく|the worst|4}…{水道管|すいどうかん|water pipe|2}が{凍った|こおった}みたい😭
dialogue.en: Happy New Year! Here it's the worst, right from New Year's Day… the water pipe seems to have frozen.

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: {田中|たなか}さん、{腰|こし}が{痛い|いたい}と{言いながら|いいながら}、{外|そと}に{見に|みに}{行こう|いこう}としてる
dialogue.en: 田中さん keeps saying his back hurts, and yet he's trying to go outside and look.

dialogue.speaker: 由紀
dialogue.jp: ネットで{見た|みた}けど、{蛇口|じゃぐち|tap, faucet|3}にタオル{巻いて|まいて|to wrap, wind|3}、ぬるま{湯|ゆ}かけるといいって
dialogue.en: I read online: wrap a towel round the tap and pour lukewarm water on it.

dialogue.speaker: 由紀
dialogue.jp: {熱湯|ねっとう|boiling water|3}はダメらしい！{割れる|われる|to crack, break|3}こともあるって
dialogue.en: Apparently boiling water is a no! It can crack.

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: {出た|でた}！{作戦|さくせん|plan, operation|3}{成功|せいこう|success|4}！{田中|たなか}さんも{笑ってる|わらってる}よ
dialogue.en: It's running! Operation success! 田中さん's laughing too.

dialogue.speaker: 由紀
dialogue.jp: よかった〜！{年賀状|ねんがじょう}{届いた|とどいた}？{絵|え}は{下手|へた}ながら、ひつじ{描いた|かいた|to draw|3}よ🐑
dialogue.en: Phew! Did my New Year card arrive? I'm bad at drawing, but I drew a sheep.
dialogue.note: 2027 is the year of the sheep (ひつじ{年|どし}).

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: {届いた|とどいた}！{残念|ざんねん|unfortunate, a pity|4}ながら、{犬|いぬ}にしか{見えない|みえない}ｗ
dialogue.en: It arrived! Sadly, it only looks like a dog lol

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: でも{最悪|さいあく|the worst|4}な{朝|あさ}だったから、すごく{嬉しかった|うれしかった}。ありがとう！
dialogue.en: But after such an awful morning, it made me really happy. Thank you!

listening.intro: That afternoon, at {初詣|はつもうで} at {鷹ノ原神社|たかのはらじんじゃ}, a loudspeaker crackles over the queue.
listening.title: {初詣|はつもうで}のご{案内|あんない}
listening.place: {鷹ノ原神社|たかのはらじんじゃ}

lines.jp: {本日|ほんじつ}はお{参り|まいり|visiting a shrine|3}の{方|かた}で{大変|たいへん}{混雑|こんざつ|crowding|2}しております。
lines.en: Today it's very crowded with people coming to pray.

lines.jp: お{守り|まもり}は、{本殿|ほんでん|main shrine hall|2}の{右側|みぎがわ}でお{受け|うけ}ください。{足元|あしもと|footing, underfoot|3}が{凍って|こおって}おりますので、ご{注意|ちゅうい}ください。
lines.en: Please receive your charms to the right of the main hall. The ground is frozen, so watch your step.

listening.question: お{守り|まもり}は、どこで{買えますか|かえますか}。
options: ほんでんのひだりがわ
listening.explain: {本殿|ほんでん}の{右側|みぎがわ} = to the right of the main hall. Shrines say お{守|まも}りを{受|う}ける (receive), not {買|か}う.

grammar.form: verb: stem + ながら ({言|い}いながら, {知|し}りながら) · い-adj: + ながら ({狭|せま}いながら, {小|ちい}さいながら) · な-adj / noun: + ながら ({下手|へた}ながら, {残念|ざんねん}ながら, {子|こ}どもながら)
grammar.explanation: Joins two things that clash: 'although, and yet'. Often with も: ながらも. {残念|ざんねん}ながら is a set phrase for 'unfortunately'. Not the 'while doing' ながら: here the second part goes against what the first suggests.

examples.jp: {颯太|そうた}は{子|こ}どもながら、{雪かき|ゆきかき}を{手伝って|てつだって}くれた。
examples.en: {颯太|そうた} is just a kid, but he helped shovel the snow.

examples.jp: {危ない|あぶない}と{知っていながら|しっていながら}、{熱湯|ねっとう|boiling water|3}をかけてしまった。
examples.en: I knew it was risky, and yet I poured boiling water on it.

quiz.question: {狭い|せまい}＿＿、{居心地|いごこち|how comfortable a place feels|3}のいい{部屋|へや}だ。
quiz.en: It's small, but it's a cosy room.
quiz.explain: い-adjectives take ながら directly: {狭|せま}いながら.

quiz_more.question: {残念|ざんねん}＿＿、{明日|あした}は{行けません|いけません}。
quiz_more.explain: な-adjectives and nouns add ながら straight on, with no な or だ.

quiz_more.question: {危ない|あぶない}と＿＿、{熱湯|ねっとう|boiling water|3}をかけてしまった。
quiz_more.en: I knew it was risky, and yet I poured boiling water on it.
quiz_more.explain: Verbs use the stem (or ている stem): {知|し}っていながら. Plain and た forms don't take ながら.

kanji.where: Printed in gold across the top of {由紀|ゆき}'s {年賀状|ねんがじょう}, above her sheep.
kanji.breakdown: {謹賀|きんが}: 謹 respectfully + 賀 celebrate → 'I humbly celebrate'; {新年|しんねん}: new + year.
kanji.related: 賀 is also in {年賀状|ねんがじょう} (New Year card).

tip.title: {水抜き|みずぬき}: draining the pipes
tip.body: In cold parts of Nagano many houses have a {水抜き栓|みずぬきせん}, a valve to empty the pipes before a very cold night. If a pipe freezes anyway, wrap it in a towel and pour lukewarm water: boiling water can crack it.

challenge.prompt: {健太|けんた}: 「あけおめ！{初詣|はつもうで}もう{行った|いった}？」 Tell him that unfortunately, because of the pipe, it's in the afternoon.
pieces: {水道管|すいどうかん}のせいで
challenge.model_answer: {残念|ざんねん|unfortunate, a pity|4}ながら、{水道管|すいどうかん|water pipe|2}のせいで{午後|ごご}になった。
challenge.explanation: {残念|ざんねん}ながら opens the sentence like 'unfortunately'. 〜のせいで blames the cause: 'because of the pipe'. Plain なった keeps it casual for {健太|けんた}.
challenge.hint: {残念|ざんねん}ながら first, then the cause with のせいで

vocab.note: {最|さい} most + {悪|あく} bad. Opposite of {最高|さいこう}.
{水道|すいどう} water supply + {管|かん} pipe.
Literally 'snake mouth'. {蛇口|じゃぐち}をひねる = turn on the tap.
マフラーを{巻|ま}く = wear a scarf. {巻|ま}き{寿司|ずし} = rolled sushi.
{熱|ねつ} hot + {湯|ゆ} hot water. Lukewarm is ぬるま{湯|ゆ}.
Glass, plates, pipes. Transitive: {割|わ}る = break something.
{成功|せいこう}する = succeed. Opposite: {失敗|しっぱい}.
Same sound as {書|か}く (write); {描|か}く is for pictures.
{残念|ざんねん}ながら = unfortunately. {残念|ざんねん}だね = what a shame.
{居|い}る being somewhere + {心地|ここち} feeling. {居心地|いごこち}がいい = cosy.

kanji_study.parts: Top: two hands bundling something together; bottom: 己, a curled-up shape → hands rolling something into a coil: to roll, to wind.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 券 (ticket): 券 has 刀 knife at the bottom; 巻 has 己.

kanji_study.parts: 戈 a halberd with a nail-like stroke hammered inside → finishing a weapon by beating it into shape: to complete, to become.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 城 (castle): 城 adds 土 earth on the left.
